monster.name: Animated Coffin
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Fausse apparence
entries: Si  animated coffin is motionless at the start of combat, it avantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if une créature hasn't observed the coffin move or act, that creature doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the coffin is animate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The animated coffin can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The animated coffin makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Coup
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}12 ({@dégât 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoningdgts.

action.name: Entrap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target has the {@condition agrippé} condition (escape {@dd 13}). Until this grapple ends, if la cible is not an Undead, la cible has the {@condition entravé} condition and takes 14 ({@dégât 4d6}) piercingdgts at the start of each of its turns. The animated coffin can grapple only une créature at a time.

monster.name: Factol Skall

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Skall casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Aura of Death
entries: Creatures within 30 mètres of Skall have disadvantage on death saving throws.

trait.name: Cosmic Annihilation
entries: A creature killed by Skall can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Skall fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Skall dies, he turns to dust. If his orrery of souls hasn't been destroyed, Skall re-forms within the Mortuary in {@dice 1d10} days. He appears within 5 mètres of the orrery.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Skall avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against any effect that turns Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Skall makes one Withering Touch attack or uses Spellcasting. He also uses Death Knell twice.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}32 ({@dégât 6d8 + 5}) colddgts plus 31 ({@dégât 7d8}) necroticdgts, and if la cible is une créature, it can't regaintouché points until the start of Skall's next turn.

action.name: Death Knell
entries: Skall points his finger at une créature he can see within 120 mètres of himself, filling la cible's mind with visions of death and the plangent toll of an iron bell. The target doit réussir on a {@dd 19}Sagesse saving throw or take 14 ({@dégât 4d6}) psychicdgts and have the {@condition effrayé} condition until the start of Skall's next turn.

action.name: Fog of Death (1/Day)
entries: Skall exudes a killing fog in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on himself. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The fog lasts until the start of Skall's next turn, and it can't be dispersed by wind. It does not move with him.

Each creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there doit faire a {@dd 19}jet de sauvegarde Constitution, taking 28 ({@dégât 8d6}) necroticdgts and 28 ({@dégât 8d6}) poisondgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one. A Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by thisdgts becomes a zombie under Skall's control. The zombie acts on Skall's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

reactionHeader: Skall can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Baleful Counterspell
entries: Skall chatters his teeth to interrupt a creature he can see within 60 feet of himself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 4th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 5th level or higher, Skall makes an Intelligence check ({@dc 10} + the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage if the spell fails.

reaction.name: Near-Death Experience
entries: In response to being hit by an attack, Skall teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The exorcist casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Incorruptible Vessel
entries: The exorcist can't be possessed by Celestials, Fiends, or Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exorcist makes two Grave Burst attacks.

action.name: Grave Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 120 m,, une cible. {@h}19 ({@dégât 3d10 + 3}) necrotic or radiantdgts (exorcist's choice).

action.name: Admit Entity {@recharge 5}
entries: The exorcist thins the veil of death for une créature it can see within 60 mètres of itself, exposing la cible to malevolent entities. The target doit faire a {@dd 14}Charisme saving throw. On a failed save, la cible takes 36 ({@dégât 8d8}) psychicdgts and has the {@conditionincapacité} condition for 1 minute, during which time it retches and babbles incoherently in a voice that is not its own. On a successful save, la cible takes half as muchdgts only. An {@conditionincapacité} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
